items.title: Ignacio Berroa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: The interviewee (Ignacio Berroa) never mentions Mike Longo. Mike Longo is only mentioned by the interviewer as the source of an anecdote about Dizzy Gillespie. Berroa responds to the interviewer's mention of Longo with 'Um hum' and 'Wow', indicating he is aware of the name in this context but no per

ctx.x: I live in the United States. I didn’t come to the United States to make a living playing Cuban music. I came here to play the music that I wanted to play. So for Americans you don’t have to because hey I’m an American this is my country, what are the possibilities that I’m going to make a living playing with a Latin band.
That’s a great analogy. I was able to do an interview with Mike Longo and he told me this little anecdote about Dizzy from the film “A Night in Havana.”
